description: Reconstruction uses projected flags without the greedy directive or a diagnostic lean (engine §7.10).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution leftmost-longest #(·w ∪ ·c), greedy
%elision-only
%rule text (w ≻ missing) | old | c
%rule w (X [+T])
               
%rule missing (M N)
%rule old ([+U] X)
%rule c (r T)
               
%rule r (X e)
%rule e ε
